parameters.content: CONTRACT: n8n chỉ orchestrate (fetch → decide → route → verify). LLM + RAG + Policy nằm 100% trong agent-service.
APPROVAL LOOP: Request Approval (PENDING) → human bấm link → Approval Decision webhook → APPROVED mới Execute. Không auto-execute khi needs_approval=true.

nodes.name: Telegram Chat In
nodes.notes: Can tao Telegram credential (bot token tu BotFather) trong n8n UI. Luu y: Telegram chi goi duoc webhook qua public URL — chay tunnel (cloudflared/ngrok) va set WEBHOOK_URL tuong ung.

nodes.name: Attach Channel Context
nodes.notes: Plumbing thuan orchestration (khong reasoning): gop DecideResponse + Event goc de giu chat_id cho nhanh NOTIFY.

nodes.name: Supervisor — Decide (agent-service)
nodes.notes: SUPERVISOR (agent-service, §4): classify -> delegate to specialists (asyncio.gather) -> aggregate -> policy gate. Returns canonical decision + specialists_used + evidence. Lau error: route to error output -> Record Failure -> TTL escalation -> Notify Human.

nodes.name: Record Decision
nodes.notes: Uses 'DailyOps Postgres' credential (auto-provisioned dev default; rotate in prod). Audit moi decision (contract 10 fields, §4 review). decision_id sinh SQL-side. raw_json bo qua chu y quote.

parameters.query: ={{ `INSERT INTO decisions (decision_id, correlation_id, event_type, entity, summary, confidence, action_type, needs_approval, policy_matched) VALUES ('dec_' || substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 8), '${$json.correlation_id}', '${$json.event.type}', '${String($json.event.entity || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}', '${String($json.decision.summary || '').replace(/'/g, "''")}', ${$json.decision.confidence}, '${$json.action_type}', ${$json.needs_approval}, '${$json.policy_matched}') RETURNING decision_id` }}

nodes.name: Append Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Send email to the ops team (ops-team@example.com). Fallback: log the outcome locally and continue. Precondition: a Gmail credential must be configured.

nodes.name: Has Telegram Chat?
nodes.notes: Co chat_id (di tu Telegram) -> reply truc tiep; khong co -> chi gui Gmail (fallback notify).

nodes.name: Reply Telegram
nodes.notes: Can gan Telegram bot credential (cung bot voi Telegram Chat In).

nodes.name: Send Gmail
nodes.notes: Can tao Gmail OAuth2 credential + sua nguoi nhan that (thay ops-team@example.com).

nodes.name: Create Ticket
nodes.notes: Uses 'DailyOps Postgres' credential (auto-provisioned dev default; rotate in prod). Can tao credential 'DailyOps Postgres' (host postgres:5432, db dailyops) trong n8n UI.

parameters.query: ={{ `INSERT INTO tickets (ticket_id, type, priority, entity, status, recommendation, confidence, correlation_id) VALUES ('tck_' || substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 8), '${$json.ticket_payload.type}', '${$json.ticket_payload.priority}', '${$json.ticket_payload.entity}', 'OPEN', '${$json.recommended_action}', ${$json.decision.confidence}, '${$json.correlation_id}') RETURNING ticket_id` }}

nodes.name: Verify Ticket
nodes.notes: Lane-local verify: INSERT returned a ticket_id. Failure -> Record Failure lane.

nodes.name: Request Approval
nodes.notes: Uses 'DailyOps Postgres' credential (auto-provisioned dev default; rotate in prod). EXECUTE can approval -> ghi approvals=PENDING va DUNG lai. Resume qua Approval Decision webhook (xem sticky).

parameters.query: ={{ `INSERT INTO approvals (correlation_id, requested_action, idempotency_key, expires_at) VALUES ('${$json.correlation_id}', '${$json.recommended_action}', '${$json.idempotency_key || ''}', now() + make_interval(hours => ${Number($env.APPROVAL_TTL_HOURS || 24)})) RETURNING correlation_id` }}

nodes.name: Notify Approver
nodes.notes: TODO: gui 2 link nay cho human qua Telegram/Gmail (thay localhost bang WEBHOOK_URL that khi deploy). Nhanh ket thuc o day — resume qua webhook.

nodes.name: Execute Target API
nodes.notes: Chi chay khi: needs_approval == false (auto), HOAC approvals row = APPROVED (resume). Khong bao gio goi truc tiep tu Route.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { ...d, error: 'Unknown action_type: ' + d.action_type } }];

nodes.name: Approval Decision
nodes.notes: Human bam link approve/reject (GET ?correlation_id=...&decision=approve|reject). Resume cua approval loop — nam trong cot EXECUTE.

nodes.name: Record Approval Decision

parameters.query: ={{ `UPDATE approvals SET status = CASE WHEN LOWER('${$json.query.decision}') = 'approve' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN LOWER('${$json.query.decision}') = 'reject' THEN 'REJECTED' END, decided_by = 'human:webhook', decided_at = now() WHERE correlation_id = '${$json.query.correlation_id}' AND status = 'PENDING' AND LOWER('${$json.query.decision}') IN ('approve', 'reject') RETURNING correlation_id` }}

nodes.notes: Uses 'DailyOps Postgres' credential (auto-provisioned dev default; rotate in prod).

nodes.name: Load Approval
nodes.notes: Uses 'DailyOps Postgres' credential (auto-provisioned dev default; rotate in prod). Doc lai approvals row (single source of truth) truoc khi cho phep Execute.

parameters.query: ={{ `SELECT requested_action, status, idempotency_key, expires_at, correlation_id FROM approvals WHERE correlation_id = '${$json.correlation_id}'` }}

nodes.name: Approved?
nodes.notes: Only status=APPROVED executes. REJECTED (or anything else) -> failure lane.

nodes.name: Close Ticket

parameters.query: ={{ `UPDATE tickets SET status='CLOSED' WHERE correlation_id='${$json.correlation_id}' RETURNING correlation_id` }}

nodes.notes: Uses 'DailyOps Postgres' credential (auto-provisioned dev default; rotate in prod).

parameters.jsCode:
const v = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { correlation_id: v.correlation_id || 'unknown', action_type: v.action_type || 'UNKNOWN', verified: true, finished_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];

nodes.name: Record Outcome
nodes.notes: Uses 'DailyOps Postgres' credential (auto-provisioned dev default; rotate in prod). Closed-loop evaluation: ghi outcome moi nhanh (success + failure), doc lap voi notify.

parameters.query: ={{ `INSERT INTO decision_outcomes (correlation_id, action_type, verified, outcome_kind) VALUES ('${$json.correlation_id}', '${$json.action_type}', ${$json.verified}, '${$json.outcome_kind}') RETURNING correlation_id` }}

nodes.name: Retry / Escalate
nodes.notes: DAILYOPS-08: phan biet UNKNOWN_OUTCOME (timeout, side-effect co the da xay ra) vs FAILED. Unknown -> reconcile (GET status theo external_operation_id) truoc khi retry; khong bao gio blind-retry side-effect. Fail -> escalate human.

nodes.name: Notify Human
nodes.notes: TODO: noi Telegram/Slack/Email node vao sau node nay (escalation).

nodes.name: Webhook Auth Guard
nodes.notes: DAILYOPS-06: webhook auth. Khi WEBHOOK_SECRET duoc set, header X-Webhook-Secret phai khop; sai/thieu -> error output -> Record Failure. De trong WEBHOOK_SECRET = open mode (chi dev).

nodes.name: Approval Auth Guard
nodes.notes: DAILYOPS-06: human approval link duoc ky HMAC-SHA256(correlation_id, WEBHOOK_SECRET) boi Notify Approver. Token sai/thieu -> error output -> Record Failure.

nodes.name: Expired?
nodes.notes: DAILYOPS-04: approval TTL — PENDING qua expires_at -> ESCALATED, khong cho PENDING vo thoi han.

nodes.name: TTL Escalate
nodes.notes: DAILYOPS-04: PENDING qua TTL -> ESCALATED (khong execute) -> Record Failure -> Notify Human.

parameters.query: ={{ `UPDATE approvals SET status = 'ESCALATED', decided_by = 'system:ttl' WHERE correlation_id = '${$json.correlation_id}' AND status = 'PENDING' RETURNING correlation_id` }}

nodes.name: Reserve Execute Idempotency
nodes.notes: DAILYOPS-05: DB-level idempotency — INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING TRUOC khi Execute Target API. Retry/replay -> conflict -> 0 rows -> Reserved? chan. alwaysOutputData removed; dedup gate is Reserved? if exclusively.

parameters.query: ={{ `INSERT INTO action_executions (idempotency_key, correlation_id, action_type, target_system) VALUES ('${$json.idempotency_key}', '${$json.correlation_id}', 'EXECUTE', 'target_api') ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING idempotency_key, correlation_id` }}

nodes.name: Reserved?
nodes.notes: Co row moi tu reserve -> duoc execute. Item rong (duplicate) -> Record Failure (audit, khong side-effect lan 2).

nodes.name: Reserve Notify Idempotency
nodes.notes: DAILYOPS-05/R8: NOTIFY lane (email/telegram) dedup DB-level — webhook replay cung idempotency_key chi gui 1 lan. alwaysOutputData removed; Reserved? if gate is sole dedup check.

parameters.query: ={{ `INSERT INTO action_executions (idempotency_key, correlation_id, action_type, target_system) VALUES ('${$json.idempotency_key}', '${$json.correlation_id}', 'NOTIFY', 'telegram_gmail') ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING idempotency_key, correlation_id` }}

nodes.name: Notify Reserved?
nodes.notes: Duplicate webhook -> 0 row -> Record Failure (khong gui email/telegram lan 2).

nodes.name: Build Execute Payload
nodes.notes: Ghep ket qua reserve (idempotency_key) voi action payload goc (tu Needs Approval? hoac Build Approved Execute) cho Execute Target API.

nodes.name: Build Notify Payload
nodes.notes: Ghep ket qua reserve voi decision goc (event/decision chat_id...) de NOTIFY lane tiep tuc dung duoc $json.event / $json.decision.

nodes.name: Aggregate Specialist Results
nodes.notes: Zone 5a: merge supervisor decision + 4 specialist outputs (structured AgentResults) into one canonical object for routing.

nodes.name: Join Specialists
nodes.notes: Fan-in barrier: waits for all 4 specialist branches, emits ONE empty item. This guarantees single execution downstream (no 4x tickets).

nodes.name: Verify Report
nodes.notes: Lane-local verify: Sheets append succeeded (failures arrive via error output). Shapes the success outcome. If sheet append timeout and external state uncertain, set verified=false and outcome_kind=UNKNOWN_OUTCOME.

nodes.name: Verify Notify
nodes.notes: Lane-local verify: Gmail/Telegram accepted (failures arrive via error output). Shapes the success outcome.

nodes.name: Verify Action
nodes.notes: Lane-local verify: business API result accepted. Throws -> failure lane on contract breach.

nodes.name: Feedback / Eval
nodes.notes: Ending block: shapes outcome + eval metrics (automation / approval / success rates) for dashboards.

parameters.jsCode:
const o = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { ...o, eval: { automated: o.verified === true, needs_human: o.verified !== true, outcome_kind: o.outcome_kind }, evaluated_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];

parameters.content:
## 📥 ① DATA SOURCES · INPUT
Triggers only — không reasoning.
Daily 08:00 / Business Event webhook / Telegram Chat In
→ Normalize Event (CLEAN: về 1 Event schema).

## 🧹🧠 ② AGENT 1 CLEAN + AGENT 2 ANALYZE
Supervisor POST /agent/decide → Attach Channel (giữ chat_id) → 4 specialists song song → Join (1 lần, chống Nx) → Aggregate → Policy ALLOW/APPROVAL/DENY.

## 🔀 ③ DECISION · DIAGNOSE
Router theo action_type:
REPORT / NOTIFY / TICKET / EXECUTE
+ fallback UNKNOWN.

## ⚙️ ④ ACTION · 4 swimlanes
REPORT (Sheet) / NOTIFY (Telegram+Gmail) / TICKET (verify→close) / EXECUTE (approval-gated).
Mỗi lane verify riêng trước khi Outcome.

## 📊 ⑤ OUTCOME · AGENT 5 REPORT
Lane-local Verify → Success / Failure → Record Outcome (Postgres).
Thất bại → Retry/Escalate → Notify Human.

## 🔁 FEEDBACK / EVAL
Outcome → metrics + eval.
Nguồn cho Grafana + cải tiến policy.
